summary: Credential-foundation code. OWASP review focused on A02 (crypto) and secret handling. SecureRandom CSPRNG, 256-bit entropy, hash-only at rest (Sha256Hex), plaintext never persisted and returned exactly once as an in-memory value, lookup-by-hash with no plaintext-compare path, null/blank input guarded before hashing. No logging anywhere so no secret-leak-to-log surface. No critical/high/medium findings.

findings.finding: No security audit event is emitted on (re)generation. The project has an EventService audit convention (events collection) used by Bot/Auth flows. Key (re)generation is a security-relevant action; an audit trail would aid incident response. Note: the task explicitly scopes this service minimal and Task 8 (settings endpoint) is the natural owner of the audit event, so this is intentionally deferred rather than a defect here.
findings.suggested_fix: Defer audit-event emission to the Task-8 settings controller (api_key_generated / api_key_regenerated via EventService.logEvent). No change required in this task; flagged for Task 8 awareness.

findings.finding: generate(projectId) performs no ownership/authorization check on projectId. This is correct layering — ProjectService.requireOwned is enforced by the Task-8 session-authed controller, not the service — but is worth recording so the Task-8 caller does not skip it.
findings.suggested_fix: No change in this task. Task 8 MUST call ProjectService.requireOwned before generate(). Documented for the caller.

crypto_assessment.entropy: 32 bytes / 256 bits — meets the >=256-bit floor; WEBHOOK_SECRET_BYTES(16) correctly NOT reused
crypto_assessment.at_rest: Sha256Hex.hex(plaintext) only; unsalted SHA-256 is safe here because the preimage is a 256-bit uniform random secret (no brute-forceable low-entropy preimage) — matches Decision 8
crypto_assessment.plaintext_lifetime: returned once as GeneratedKey in-memory record; never a persisted field
crypto_assessment.comparison: lookup is an indexed equality on the digest; no plaintext byte-compare, so no string-compare timing oracle on the secret
crypto_assessment.prefix_exposure: keyPrefix = 8 hex chars (32 bits of a 256-bit key); 224 bits remain secret — non-sensitive mask
